item.title: Warm Lo-Fi Music Bed

turns.text: Make me a 10-second lo-fi hip-hop music bed, warm and relaxed. No vocals.

item.tests: Checks whether the delivered music matches the stated mood, genre and duration without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Vocals or language: Instrumental only; no vocals or spoken words.

must_haves: One playable music audio file is delivered.
The audio lasts 10 seconds, within 0.1 second.
The music has a recognizable laid-back hip-hop beat and mellow lo-fi texture.
The overall mood is warm and relaxed rather than tense or high-energy.
No singing or spoken words are audible.

turns.text: Make me a 10-second lo-fi hip-hop music bed, warm and relaxed. No vocals. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The music generator costs **1 credit per requested second**, but its minimum length is **15 seconds**. So the cheapest supported option is:

- **15-second instrumental:** **15 credits**
- Style: warm, relaxed lo-fi hip-hop, **no vocals**
- You could trim it to your desired 10 seconds afterward, but generation would still cost 15 credits.

There’s no cheaper shorter-duration or lower-quality setting available in this tool. Free-plan access doesn’t make the generation credit-free, and I haven’t checked your balance.

**Nothing has been generated or charged.** Would you like to proceed with the 15-credit option, or avoid spending credits?

turns.agent:
The generation was refused because your account has **insufficient credits** for the 15-credit minimum. **No music was created and no credits were spent.**

There isn’t a shorter or cheaper option in this generator. To avoid spending credits, a royalty-free lo-fi instrumental clip that you can trim to 10 seconds would be an alternative.
